# Lab 16.3: Build & Publish a Data Agent

## What We Are Going to Do
Build a data agent with knowledge sources, instructions, a glossary and verified queries, then publish it for business users.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Create the agent.** **Agents → Data agents → New agent**. Name it `thelook_sales_agent`. Add the four thelook tables as **knowledge sources**.

2. **[Console] Write instructions.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • TEXT
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">You answer questions about TheLook e-commerce sales.
- "Revenue" means SUM(order_items.sale_price) for status = 'Complete'.
- "Active customer" means a user with at least one order in the last 90 days.
- Use calendar months. Show money in USD with 2 decimals.
- If a question is ambiguous, state the assumption you used.</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[Console] Add glossary terms.** *AOV* = average order value = revenue ÷ number of completed orders. *Return rate* = returned items ÷ all items.

4. **[Console] Add a verified query.** Question: *"What is the monthly revenue?"* with SQL:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT DATE_TRUNC(DATE(created_at), MONTH) AS month, ROUND(SUM(sale_price), 2) AS revenue
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items`
WHERE status = 'Complete'
GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Verified queries are trusted examples the agent reuses for similar questions.

5. **[Console] Test in the preview pane.** Ask *"What was AOV last month?"* and *"What is our return rate by category?"*. Check that the definitions are used.

6. **[Console] Publish and share.** Click **Publish**. Then **Share** with a colleague as **Data Agent User**. They can now use it in BigQuery, Data Studio or through the API.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Instructions | Business definitions the agent follows |
| Glossary | Terms like AOV and return rate |
| Verified queries | Trusted SQL examples |
| Published | Usable by others with the right role |
